marta: Quick share — ran regional L4/T4/A10G comparatives for embeddings + small-chat. Putting raw numbers below and a few config notes. TL;DR: A10G wins latency and throughput, L4 is the best price/perf sweet spot for small deployments, T4 is cheapest per-hour but suffers p95 latency for chat.

bench-bot: Job 1762348901 completed. Artifacts: https://s3.company-internal/bench/1762348901/index.html (charts + raw CSVs).

devon: Can you paste the main latency / throughput table here?

marta: Sure — these are median of 3 runs (stable load), small-chat = 7B q4f16 variant, embeddings = openembed-2-small. Regions: us-west1 (primary) and eu-west1.

marta: ```
Small-chat (7B q4f16, avg request 60 tokens)
GPU   p95-lat(ms)   toks/s   est $ per 100k tok
A10G  45            2,200    $2.40
L4    70            1,100    $1.10
T4    120            600     $0.60

Embeddings (openembed-2-small, 768d)
GPU   p99-lat(ms)   qps     est $ per 100k embeddings
A10G  30            950     $1.10
L4    55            480     $0.55
T4    90            220     $0.28
```

liam: Were these runs using continuous batching and prefix/KV cache? Also what quant & kernels used?

marta: Yes — continuous batching enabled (auto window), prefix/KV cache warmed with ~35% hit on chat runs. Quant: q4f16 on A10G/L4 for chat; T4 runs used q8 with activation offloading for memory reasons. Embeddings ran q8 across T4 and L4; A10G used q4 for top perf. Kernel choices: A10G used cuda+flash_attn2; L4 used fused_kernels + custom matmul path; T4 fell back to cuBLAS mostly. nvfuser toggled off for chat on T4 due to instability.

devon: Region diffs? Any cross-region perf surprises?

marta: us-west1 vs eu-west1: A10G p95 ~10-15% lower in us-west1 for small-chat (network + colo). For embeddings the cross-region gap was smaller (~5%). Also memory pressure on T4 in eu-west1 forced lower concurrency causing throughput drop ~10%.

ana: Any evaluation on quality regressions from q4 vs q8 for chat?

marta: Short answer: minor. On our convo-eval set (avg len 120) q4f16 had a ~2% drop in answer-coherence score vs fp16 baseline — mostly at long context (>512). For embeddings cosine-sim correlation with fp16 was >0.98 for q4 and ~0.96 for q8. So embeddings safe; chat needs guardrails for long-history prompts.

liam: Capacity planning note? how to size if we need 10k concurrent users with avg 20 toks/req?

marta: Back-of-envelope: 10k users * 20 toks * 1 req/sec => 200k toks/s. Using small-chat A10G=2.2k toks/s -> ~91 A10G GPUs. L4 at 1.1k toks/s -> ~182 L4 GPUs. But you can tier: serve embeddings + low-latency routing on A10G and best-effort on L4. Also batching and KV cache can cut tokens/s demand by ~20-35% depending on locality.

bench-bot: :white_check_mark: artifacts uploaded and charts include per-region kernel breakdown and loss-vs-quant plots.

devon: Nice, next steps: run an A/B with a candidate 7B-optimized variant on A10G and add the per-token cost breakdown to the console dashboard. Can you queue a canary in eu-west1 next Tues?

marta: Yep — scheduling canary for eu-west1 Tue 09:00. I'll add the per-token breakdown to the route dashboard and include a column for kernel fallback.

ana: Thx — also let's flag the q4 chat reg test in the regression alert (small drop but worth watching).

marta: Will add eval + alert.
